text_en: Come on, you heard that Valkyrie. We've got work to do. Snap out of it!
Though, if you are on this road, that means you're assigned to the group tasked with exploring the cave. The rest are way ahead.
As you can see, this is no joke, so wake up and open your eyes because this place is full of disgusting creatures like that one.
Anyway, I'm off. I've wasted too much time on you already.
Do yourself a favor and try not to lag behind.
Luckily for you that creature was noisy enough to grab my attention.
Don't thank me. Better if I don't have to save your skin ever again.
What's wrong? Don't you know how to <color=IMP>dodge</color> and <color=IMP>block</color> enemy attacks?
Tssk... You know... I don't know anything about this place either. What I do know is that if you don't learn how to move, you won't last longer than a loose coin in the slums of Zarga.
The sooner you realise that, the better.
Go on, get moving. I'll keep an eye out around here.
